_comment: F4 ground truth — transcribed by hand from a photograph of a real Serbian fiscal receipt,
2026-08-15. This is the expected output; the photograph itself belongs in private/ because
it carries a cashier's name (personal data), which is deliberately omitted here.
The receipt is a DILIGAF business fuel purchase — the M1 flagship case
Arithmetic verified: 38.74 L x 202.00 RSD/L = 7825.48; PDV 20% of the gross = 1304.25;
net = 6521.23. Any extraction rung disagreeing with these numbers is wrong.
The QR on this receipt could NOT be read by any phone scanner the owner tried — see
the note in 08-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md on spike S-QR. That is a finding about layer 1's real
hit rate, not a property of this one receipt.

source.paper: thermal, folded across the upper third

findings.note: Fiscal receipts print a DOT decimal separator (7825.48, 1304.25, 202.00, 0.00). This is the INVERSE of the grammar users type into WhatsApp, where '.' groups thousands and ',' is the decimal. extract/fiscal-receipt-regex.ts must NOT reuse money.ts parseAmount. The two conventions are deliberately handled by separate parsers; do not DRY them.

The 20% PDV label is 'Ђ', named 'О-ПДВ'. It also appears on the item line in parentheses — 'EVRO PREMIUM BMB-95, 2710124500 /LIT (Ђ)' — which is how per-item VAT is attributed on a multi-rate receipt. The TaxCore sample response in the docs uses a demo tenant with FRENCH labels (TVA exo. conv., 21%/9%) and must not be treated as representative.

'ИД купца: 10:111886391' carries DILIGAF's own PIB — prefix '10:' is the ID-type code for PIB. A fiscal receipt printed with DILIGAF's PIB is a business expense BY CONSTRUCTION; one without it is personal. Deterministic, free at layer 1, needs no model. Potentially valuable because PERSONAL and DILIGAF share a phone (Q13), so resolveBook alone cannot separate them. Not currently in any spec — see 08-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md.
Seller PIB 104052135 and buyer PIB 111886391 are both exactly 9 digits, consistent with the extract/validate rule.
ПФР време prints as DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS ('06.08.2026 19:21:03'). Note 11.08.2026-style dates must be refused by money.ts parseAmount (pinned) — the receipt date parser is a separate concern.
